gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.5 to 5.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 1 to 200 Hz.

hold_decay.label: Fall while held
hold_decay.hover: The fastest the level can fall while the key stays down, so a quick lift still leaves a tail. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.02 to 4 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 6 s.

rel_speed.label: Release by lift speed
rel_speed.hover: How much a quick lift-off shortens the tail: 0 no effect, higher cuts it short. Range 0 to 8.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 2.5.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.005 to 0.4 s.

acc_key.label: Accent by register
acc_key.hover: How much longer the accent lasts on low notes than on high ones. Range 0 to 0.06.

acc_cutoff.label: Accent cutoff
acc_cutoff.hover: How far the filter opens at a strike, in semitones. Range 0 to 48 semitones.

acc_drive.label: Accent drive
acc_drive.hover: The extra saturation at a strike. Range 0 to 2.

acc_sync.label: Accent sync
acc_sync.hover: The extra sync sweep at a strike, in semitones, when timbre is up. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

acc_pitch.label: Accent pitch
acc_pitch.hover: A pitch offset at the strike that fades with the accent: below 0 the note scoops up, above 0 it drops in. Range -1 to 1 semitones.

cut_base.label: Cutoff
cut_base.hover: Where the filter sits when closed, as a note number. Range -20 to 80 note.

cut_key.label: Cutoff tracking
cut_key.hover: How much the cutoff follows the note: 1 keeps the tone the same up the keyboard. Range 0 to 1.2.

cut_env.label: Cutoff by pressure
cut_env.hover: How far pressure opens the filter. Range 0 to 80 semitones.

cut_back.label: Cutoff, timbre down
cut_back.hover: How far the filter closes with timbre down. Range -24 to 24 semitones.

cut_fwd.label: Cutoff, timbre up
cut_fwd.hover: How far the filter opens with timbre up. Range -24 to 24 semitones.

res.label: Resonance
res.hover: The filter's resonance: near 0.98 it rings on its own. Range 0 to 0.98.

res_back.label: Resonance, timbre down
res_back.hover: How much timbre down adds to the resonance. Range -0.5 to 0.98.

res_fwd.label: Resonance, timbre up
res_fwd.hover: How much timbre up takes from the resonance. Range -0.5 to 0.98.

bass_comp.label: Bass compensation
bass_comp.hover: How much the bass is brought back as the resonance rises. Range 0 to 1.

drive.label: Drive
drive.hover: The saturation after the filter. Range 0.1 to 3.

drive_env.label: Drive by pressure
drive_env.hover: How much more saturation pressure adds. Range 0 to 3.

saw.label: Saw
saw.hover: The level of the main sawtooth. Range 0 to 1.

saw_back.label: Saw, timbre down
saw_back.hover: How much timbre down reduces the saw. Range 0 to 1.

saw_fwd.label: Saw, timbre up
saw_fwd.hover: How much timbre up reduces the saw. Range 0 to 1.

saw2.label: Second saw
saw2.hover: The level of the detuned second sawtooth. Range 0 to 1.

saw2_back.label: Second saw, timbre down
saw2_back.hover: How much timbre down reduces the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

saw2_fwd.label: Second saw, timbre up
saw2_fwd.hover: How much timbre up reduces the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

saw2_detune.label: Second saw detune
saw2_detune.hover: How far the second saw is detuned. Range -0.5 to 0.5 semitones.

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.hover: The level of the pulse wave. Range 0 to 1.

pulse_back.label: Pulse, timbre down
pulse_back.hover: How much timbre down adds pulse. Range 0 to 1.

pwm.label: Pulse width sweep
pwm.hover: How far the pulse width sweeps. Range 0 to 0.4.

pwm_hz.label: Pulse width rate
pwm_hz.hover: How fast the pulse width sweeps. Range 0.05 to 8 Hz.

sub.label: Sub
sub.hover: The level of the sub-oscillator an octave down. Range 0 to 1.

sub_base.label: Sub at rest
sub_base.hover: How much of the sub sounds with the timbre at rest. Range 0 to 1.

sub_back.label: Sub, timbre down
sub_back.hover: How much timbre down adds sub. Range 0 to 1.

sub_fwd.label: Sub, timbre up
sub_fwd.hover: How much timbre up takes from the sub. Range 0 to 1.

b_sync.label: B synced
b_sync.hover: Whether the second oscillator is hard-synced to the first (on) or runs free and detuned (off). Range off or on.

b_level.label: B level
b_level.hover: The level of the second oscillator. Range 0 to 1.

b_fwd.label: B, timbre up
b_fwd.hover: How much timbre up adds of the second oscillator. Range 0 to 1.

b_detune.label: B detune
b_detune.hover: How far down the second oscillator is detuned when it runs free. Range -0.5 to 0.5 semitones.

sync.label: Sync ratio
sync.hover: How far above the note the synced oscillator runs, with timbre up. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

sync_fwd.label: Sync, timbre up
sync_fwd.hover: How much further timbre up sweeps the sync. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

sync_env.label: Sync by pressure
sync_env.hover: How far pressure sweeps the sync. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

tilt_home.label: Timbre home
tilt_home.hover: Where the timbre sits while the timbre control is centred: below 0 down, above 0 up. Range -1 to 1.

drift.label: Pitch drift
drift.hover: A slow wander of the main oscillator's pitch. Range 0 to 0.3 semitones.

saw2_drift.label: Second saw drift
saw2_drift.hover: A slow wander of the second saw's pitch. Range 0 to 0.3 semitones.

cut_drift.label: Cutoff drift
cut_drift.hover: A slow wander of the filter cutoff. Range 0 to 2 semitones.

gyro_chorus.label: Chorus by rotation
gyro_chorus.hover: How much rotation (the motion input) detunes the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

vibrato.label: Vibrato by shake
vibrato.hover: How much vibrato a shake (the motion input) adds, in semitones at a full shake. Range 0 to 1.5 semitones.

vib_hz.label: Vibrato rate
vib_hz.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 1 to 9 Hz.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.
